description: Use this when the user asks what is moving, trending or changing on Polymarket, what moved overnight or this week, or for the biggest gainers and losers. Ranks the 300 most-traded open markets by price change over the last hour, day, week or month, with old and current price, the move in percentage points, 24h volume and the slug for follow-ups (pm_flow shows who moved it). Markets that are merely settling and live sports games are left out unless include_games is true.

direction.description: both (default), up only, or down only.

include_games.description: Include individual sports games, whose prices move with the score (default false).

min_volume_24h_usd.description: Skip markets that traded less than this in the last 24h (default $10,000).

name: pm_moves
title: Biggest price moves
